entry.title: Confirmed: Apple launches OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros and an M6 lineup at its Oct 28 launch
entry.summary: At its Oct 28 launch Apple will announce OLED touchscreen 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros (M5 Pro/Max), an OLED iPad mini, a 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro and an M6 iMac, with sales from Nov 6.

entry.title: Confirmed: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro both get 200MP main cameras
entry.summary: Both OnePlus Ace 7 models will use a 200MP main camera, and the Pro adds a 50MP 3.5x periscope.

entry.title: Confirmed: Samsung's China-only W27 is a premium Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra
entry.summary: Samsung will release a W27 in China, a more premium Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra in blue with gold accents.

entry.title: Confirmed: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, the successor to Argon, within weeks
entry.summary: Google's next Gemini 4 checkpoint, Carbon, is in partner early access and will be released publicly soon.

entry.title: Rumor: Motorola Signature 27 costs about €1,595 in Europe, and a Razr Flex 27 about €1,511
entry.summary: The Motorola Signature 27 (12GB/512GB) will cost €1,594.90 in Europe, up nearly 60% from the first Signature's €999, and the unannounced Razr Flex 27 (12GB/256GB) will cost €1,510.90.

entry.title: Shaky: Apple relaxed iPhone Duo quality checks to ship more units
entry.summary: Apple lowered quality inspection standards for the iPhone Duo to get more units to stores before the holidays, as it targets 7.5 million shipments by year end.

entry.title: Likely: The base Galaxy S27 stays at 25W wired charging
entry.summary: The standard Galaxy S27 will charge at 25W wired, the same as the Galaxy S26, while the S27 Pro and Ultra get 60W.

entry.title: Confirmed: Huawei adds a Pura 90 Plus with a 1-inch variable-aperture camera
entry.summary: Huawei is preparing a Pura 90 Plus with a 50MP 1-inch-type RYYB variable-aperture main camera in a triple setup, a 6.8-inch 1.5K screen and four colors.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung adds a Galaxy Z Fold 9 Plus or Fold 9 FE next to the wide Fold 9
entry.summary: Samsung is testing two extra wide-format Fold 9 variants, a larger 'Plus' and a cheaper, spec-trimmed 'FE', and will pick one to sell alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 9.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo is testing an X500s with a 6.85-inch flat 2K 144Hz screen
entry.summary: vivo has a 'small s iteration' of the X500 series in testing with a 6.85-inch flat screen, 2K+ resolution, 144Hz and equal bezels, likely the X500s.

entry.title: Likely: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max cost EUR 1,449-1,849 in Europe with smaller batteries
entry.summary: The European Xiaomi 18 Pro will cost EUR 1,449 (256GB) or EUR 1,649 (512GB) with a 6,000mAh-rated battery and 90W charging, and the 18 Pro Max EUR 1,849 (512GB) with a 7,050mAh-rated battery and 100W, both smaller than the Chinese versions' 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh.

entry.title: Confirmed: OpenAI releases a cheaper GPT-6.1 Terra model that beats GPT-6.1 Sol
entry.summary: OpenAI is about to release GPT-6.1 Terra, a new model in its Terra tier that outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol while costing less.

entry.title: Rumor: BYD's Yangwang Altior luxury sedan debuts in Dubai around Nov 5 with solid-state batteries
entry.summary: BYD will unveil its 5.5-meter Yangwang Altior executive sedan in Dubai around Nov 5, as the first car with BYD's solid-state batteries, priced around 2 million yuan.

entry.title: Rumor: Oppo Find X10 Ultra gets a LOFIC 200MP main camera, two periscopes and a 100MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The Find X10 Ultra will have a 200MP 1/1.12-inch main camera with LOFIC, a 200MP periscope, a 50MP 10x periscope and a 100MP square-sensor selfie camera.

entry.title: Rumor: Motorola Edge 70 Neo has a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 7,000mAh battery and 144Hz screen
entry.summary: The Edge 70 Neo will have a 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera, 32MP selfie camera, 7,000mAh battery with 45W charging and IP64.

entry.title: Rumor: Bloober Team's Silent Hill remake targets a 2027 release
entry.summary: Bloober Team's remake of the first Silent Hill, cast under the codename 'Project Noise', is aiming for a 2027 release.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone 18e keeps a 60Hz screen but gets the A20 and possibly a 24MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch 60Hz LTPS OLED screen, the 2nm A20 chip, a single 48MP rear camera and maybe a 24MP front camera.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung's Exynos 2700 beats Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 phones in internal tests
entry.summary: In Samsung's internal tests the Exynos 2700 for the Galaxy S27 beat the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max (Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6) by about 20% in Geekbench 6.5 multi-core and posted 5-20% higher GPU results.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung cuts Galaxy A phone production by about 20% to protect flagships
entry.summary: Samsung has cut fourth-quarter Galaxy A component orders by about 20% versus its plan, about 10 million phones a year, and plans to cut Galaxy A output by more than 10% again in 2027, shifting resources to flagships as memory costs soar.

entry.title: Rumor: Xbox turns Game Pass into a pick-your-features subscription
entry.summary: Microsoft will overhaul Game Pass into a tiered base plan with à la carte add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming and multiplayer.

entry.title: Likely: Samsung readies a Galaxy Fit 4 that looks just like the Fit 3
entry.summary: Samsung will launch a Galaxy Fit 4 (SM-R391) fitness band with a near-identical design to the Fit 3, in black, white and light blue, at a similar low price.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone Duo 2 gets under-display Face ID
entry.summary: Apple's second-generation iPhone Duo, expected next fall, adds Face ID under the outer display, and Apple is also considering an Action button.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor 700 series launches in November with three models and a rear screen on the Pro
entry.summary: Honor will launch three Honor 700 models in China in November; the 700 Pro has a 6.57-inch 1.5K screen, a 200MP main camera, a 50MP periscope telephoto, a 1.72-inch built-in rear display and a battery of about 9,000mAh.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo S70 launches soon with a 64MP periscope that supports a teleconverter
entry.summary: vivo's next S-series phone, the S70, has a 64MP Sony LYT610 periscope telephoto with teleconverter support, a 6.59-inch 1.5K LTPS OLED screen and a Snapdragon 8s-series chip.

entry.title: Rumor: Realme 17 Pro series gets a 10,000mAh battery, 200MP camera and 3.5x telephoto
entry.summary: An upcoming Realme 17 Pro or 17 Pro+ has a flat 1.5K 120Hz OLED (165Hz in some games), the Dimensity 7500, a 200MP main camera, a 50MP 3.5x telephoto, a 10,000mAh battery and a plastic frame.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo X500 Ultra uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a huge battery and a bigger 200MP telephoto
entry.summary: The vivo X500 Ultra launches in China around March-April 2027 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a flat 6.85-inch BOE LTPO screen, an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, a 7,000-8,000mAh battery, a 50MP Sony LYT910 35mm main camera and a 200MP 1/1.2-inch telephoto.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple weighs a future iPhone Duo with a roughly 8-inch inner screen
entry.summary: Apple is looking at a future iPhone Duo whose inner display is about half an inch larger (roughly 7.9 to 8.1 inches, versus 7.6 today), replacing rather than joining the current size.

entry.title: Rumor: Valve is working on a new Half-Life game codenamed 'HLX'
entry.summary: 'HLX', a codename first found in 2024 game files, is an active Valve project, widely assumed to be a new Half-Life game.

entry.title: Shaky: Tesla unveils Optimus V3 before the end of 2026
entry.summary: Tesla will publicly show its Optimus V3 humanoid robot in 2026.
